2. (59.48, 13.19)  
3. (56.18, 22.48)  
4. (45.06, 28.08)  
— M (move to same point) — no new point  
5. (35.12, 22.33)  
— M (move to same point) — no new point  
6. (30.70, 15.63)  
7. (38.15, 4.18)  
8. (54.66, 5.02) — back to start  

So the vertices in order are:  
(54.66,5.02) → (59.48,13.19) → (56.18,22.48) → (45.06,28.08) → (35.12,22.33) → (30.70,15.63) → (38.15,4.18) → (54.66,5.02)  

That’s 8 distinct vertices, forming a single closed polygon because the last point connects to the first.  

An 8-sided polygon is an octagon.  

Final answer: (F)
